import bpy,json,numpy as np
from mathutils import Vector
from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['facade16'];craft=ns['craft'];bank=ns['bank'];cap=ns['cap'];at=ns['at']
assert craft.get('facade16_ground') and not craft.get('facade16_contacts')
def sm(a,b,x):
 t=min(1.,max(0.,(x-a)/(b-a)));return t*t*(3-2*t)
# A compact earth seat supports the pre-existing crate stack at its true height.
for v in bank.data.vertices:
 x,y,z=v.co;w=sm(3.88,4.12,x)*(1-sm(5.12,5.48,x))*sm(3.42,3.73,y)*(1-sm(5.77,6.12,y))
 v.co.z=z+(1.492-z)*w
bank.data.update()
tree=BVHTree.FromPolygons([bank.matrix_world@v.co for v in bank.data.vertices],[list(p.vertices) for p in bank.data.polygons]);ns['ground_tree']=tree
def shift(prefixes,targetxy,embed):
 obs=[o for o in craft.objects if o.name.startswith(prefixes)]
 pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(p) for o in obs for p in o.bound_box];bottom=min(v.z for v in pts)
 delta=at(tree,*targetxy)-embed-bottom
 for o in obs:o.location.z+=delta
 return {'objects':[o.name for o in obs],'xy':targetxy,'ground':at(tree,*targetxy),'old_bottom':bottom,'new_bottom':bottom+delta,'delta':delta}
moves=[
 shift(('Combined_rear_B parts crate',),(4.6,4.7),.003),
 shift(('Combined_rear_B spare anchor','Combined_rear_B anchor '),(4.2,3.6),.015),
 shift(('Combined_rear_B leaning shovel','Combined_rear_B shovel blade'),(4.05,3.05),.018)
]
placement=json.loads((ns['root']/'captures/shipyard_stone_20261115/plant_placement.json').read_text())
plantmoves=[]
for j,dest in [(4,(6.15,5.25)),(5,(6.44,5.96))]:
 oldxy=placement[j]['xy'];obs=[o for o in craft.objects if o.name.startswith('S15 salt shoulder bed '+str(j)+' leaf')]
 assert len(obs)==7
 oldground=at(ns['old_ground_tree'],*oldxy);newground=at(tree,*dest)
 delta=Vector((dest[0]-oldxy[0],dest[1]-oldxy[1],newground-oldground))
 for o in obs:o.location+=delta
 plantmoves.append({'bed':j,'from':oldxy,'to':dest,'delta':list(delta),'ground':newground})
craft['facade16_contacts']=True
(cap/'contact_pass.json').write_text(json.dumps({'props':moves,'plant_moves':plantmoves,'crate_earth_seat':1.492},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf8')
bpy.context.view_layer.update();bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
print('F16_CONTACTS',[(len(m['objects']),m['delta']) for m in moves],'moved plants',plantmoves)
